newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Bank of NY names Russia's Uneximbank subdepositary.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY names Russia's Uneximbank subdepositary.

text.p: The Bank of New York has named Uneximbank its sub-depositary on the Russian equities market, Uneximbank said on Friday.
The signing of the agreement will take place in September or start of October, Uneximbank said in a statement.

Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) will be able to hold Russian company shares purchased by Bank of New York clients and handle some other depositary activities, excluding operations with American Depositary Receipts, it said.

In May the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission granted Uneximbank, Russia's fourth biggest bank by assets, the status of a reliable foreign depositary. U.S. investment companies can only work abroad with companies with a "reliable foreign depositary" status.
